verified: Four PredictPrompt adopters: keyboard Space selects radio, Enter locks; computed feedback receives focus; changing context clears feedback and selection; Skip reveals; dismissal survives reload; Reveal result unblocks the model.
Default reduced motion pauses gradient descent. Reveal stays at step 1 until manual Step. Explicit Resume plus Play advances; global Pause holds the step, with Step still available.
Light and Detailed quality both render; genuine WebGL canvas pixel width increases under Detailed at device scale factor 2; model metrics remain equal; quality preference persists.
Regression, SVM, decision trees and attention controls change the model/readouts; visible axes use neutral rgb(148,163,184).
Native SceneKey mobile disclosures on regression and Bayes open and close by keyboard, remain within viewport, and do not overlap controls.
All representative scene drawers close on Escape and restore focus to Open scene panel.
LA/calculus/probability Start path and in-scene Next work by keyboard and retain their path id; mobile initial drawer is closed.
All non-ML card thumbnails are static SVG, with multiple artworks per topic and no thumbnail canvas.
coverageNotes: Family preview motifs are intentionally reused; plan.md P6.2 asks for approximately ten motifs over 75 lessons, so this does not claim unique artwork for every lesson.
SVM, tree and attention do not instantiate native SceneKey; their captions/labels explain geometry instead. The common disclosure checks apply to actual regression and Bayes instances.
Disabled-WebGL Eigen uses aria-labelledby SVG; a supplementary direct check verifies Reveal grows the alignment map from 0 to 306 circles and updates its SVG description.
Targeted browser QA, not a physical-device GPU performance benchmark or formal WCAG certification.
